one_line: LLMs edit weights, safety proofs debut, AI firms raise billions, and city AI deployments expand globally.

themes.title: LLMs read and edit weights
themes.text: MIT researchers showed a GPT‑6 Astra model can modify a neural network’s parameters, improving performance on MATH‑500 and GSM8K. Simon Willison demonstrated that the Qwen 3.8 27B model can read and reason about raw weight files on a laptop.

stories.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining
Simon Willison shows Qwen 3.8 27B can interpret raw model weights

themes.title: AI firms raise billions for scaling
themes.text: Meta plans a cross‑border bond sale targeting at least $20 billion for AI and data‑center expansion. Fal’s Series F round valued the inference startup at $16 billion after a $1.3 billion raise. Traversal secured $120 million at a $1 billion valuation to grow its AI‑driven SRE platform. PowerUp Money raised $10 million to expand its AI‑led wealth‑management service in India.

stories.headline: Meta targets at least $20 billion in cross‑border bond offering, debuting euro tranche
AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
Traversal raises $120 million at $1 billion valuation to expand AI‑driven site reliability engineering
PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India

themes.title: AI services deployed in cities worldwide
themes.text: NVIDIA and partners are installing physical and agentic AI, including resident‑service bots, vision agents, and traffic‑management agents, in cities across Europe, Asia and the United States, supporting thousands of cameras by 2027.

stories.headline: NVIDIA expands physical and agentic AI services to cities worldwide
